name: Chronicle, CrowdStrike, Cortex, Elastic — hunting playbook
description: The same handful of high value hunts expressed on the remaining platforms. Each template declares its own dialect, so one pack serves several consoles.

templates.name: Failed logins grouped by source
templates.description: Set the window in the console time picker before running.

templates.name: PowerShell with an encoded command
templates.body:
metadata.event_type = "PROCESS_LAUNCH" AND
target.process.file.full_path = /powershell(\.exe)?$/ nocase AND
re.regex(target.process.command_line, `(?i)(-enc|-EncodedCommand|FromBase64String)`)

templates.name: PowerShell with an encoded command
templates.body:
#event_simpleName = ProcessRollup2
| FileName = /powershell(\.exe)?$/i
| CommandLine = /(-enc|-EncodedCommand|FromBase64String)/i
| table([@timestamp, ComputerName, UserName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName])
| sort(@timestamp, order=desc)

templates.name: Office applications spawning a shell
templates.body:
#event_simpleName = ProcessRollup2
| ParentBaseFileName = /^(winword|excel|powerpnt|outlook)\.exe$/i
| FileName = /^(powershell|pwsh|cmd|wscript|cscript|mshta|rundll32|regsvr32)\.exe$/i
| table([@timestamp, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, FileName, CommandLine])
| sort(@timestamp, order=desc)

templates.name: Autorun registry keys modified
templates.body:
#event_simpleName = /^(AsepValueUpdate|RegSystemConfigValueUpdate)$/
| RegObjectName = /CurrentVersion\\Run/i
| table([@timestamp, ComputerName, RegObjectName, RegValueName, RegStringValue])
| sort(@timestamp, order=desc)

templates.name: PowerShell with an encoded command
templates.body:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS
  and action_process_image_name ~= "(?i)powershell(\.exe)?"
  and action_process_image_command_line ~= "(?i)(-enc|-EncodedCommand|FromBase64String)"
| fields _time, agent_hostname, actor_effective_username, action_process_image_command_line
| sort desc _time

templates.name: Office applications spawning a shell
templates.body:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS
  and actor_process_image_name in ("winword.exe", "excel.exe", "powerpnt.exe", "outlook.exe")
  and action_process_image_name in ("powershell.exe", "cmd.exe", "wscript.exe", "cscript.exe", "mshta.exe", "rundll32.exe")
| fields _time, agent_hostname, actor_process_image_name, action_process_image_name, action_process_image_command_line
| sort desc _time

templates.name: Failed authentications grouped by source
templates.body:
FROM logs-*
| WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 24 hours
| WHERE event.category == "authentication" AND event.outcome == "failure"
| STATS failures = COUNT(*), accounts = COUNT_DISTINCT(user.name) BY source.ip
| WHERE failures > 10
| SORT failures DESC

templates.name: PowerShell with an encoded command
templates.body:
FROM logs-*
| WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 24 hours
| WHERE process.name == "powershell.exe"
| WHERE process.command_line RLIKE "(?i).*(-enc|-encodedcommand|frombase64string).*"
| KEEP @timestamp, host.name, user.name, process.parent.name, process.command_line
| SORT @timestamp DESC

templates.name: Rare parent and child process pairs
templates.description: Frequency analysis over process ancestry: the rare pairs are where the interesting things hide.
templates.body:
FROM logs-*
| WHERE @timestamp > NOW() - 7 days
| WHERE event.category == "process" AND event.type == "start"
| STATS executions = COUNT(*), hosts = COUNT_DISTINCT(host.name)
        BY process.parent.name, process.name
| WHERE executions < 10
| SORT executions ASC
